# HVE Core practice map

The quests should point learners toward the relevant HVE Core practice areas: Documentation; RPI research; Design Thinking and UX; meeting analysis and requirements; functional planning and backlog management; architecture review and ADRs; root-cause analysis; security planning and review; supply-chain security; accessibility and privacy; responsible AI and experiment design; and implementation, code review, and reporting.

Names and availability vary by installed HVE Core version. Phrase these as suggested practice areas, then have the learner use the actual installed skills, agents, or tools. Do not claim a native invocation when a task was only simulated or discussed.
